upload.title: Share a spot
upload.subtitle: Add a photo and details so neighbors can find this parking.
upload.legalWarning: Only share legal, public parking. Do not mark private entrances or restricted areas as free spots.
upload.stepPhotoDesc: Add a clear photo of the parking spot.
upload.stepLocationDesc: Place the spot on the map or enter coordinates.
upload.stepDetailsDesc: Describe the spot and who it suits.
upload.dropzoneTitle: Drag & drop a photo, or click to select
upload.dropzoneHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP · up to 10 MB
upload.privacyNote: Your photo stays private — it's only shown on the spot's page.
upload.locationHint: Search for an address or place, then fine-tune the pin by clicking the map. No reverse geocoding — clicking the map updates coordinates only.
upload.descriptionPlaceholder: Anything that helps drivers find or judge this spot…
upload.legalStatusHint: Spots marked illegal/risky cannot be created — the backend rejects them.
upload.legalUncertain: Rules are unclear or vary by time.
upload.legalRisky: Parking here may be prohibited or risky.
upload.illegalRejected: The backend rejects creating spots marked illegal/risky (ILLEGAL_SPOT_REJECTED). Submitting will fail.
upload.retryHint: Your photo was uploaded successfully. Fix the details and submit again — the spot will be created without re-uploading the photo.
upload.createErrorRetry: Could not create spot. Please review the details and try again.
upload.successRedirect: Thanks for contributing. Redirecting you to your new spot…

unsavedChanges.title: Leave parking spot sharing?
unsavedChanges.description: You have unsaved changes. If you leave now, your progress on this parking spot submission will be lost.
